parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: The text to be detected. It can contain up to 10,000 characters (including punctuation marks). Only Chinese text can be detected.

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The name of the project. For more information, see [CreateProject](~~478153~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun imm detect-text-anomaly --project-name immtest --content content --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun imm DetectTextAnomaly --region cn-hangzhou --ProjectName immtest --Content content
